exposure: cervical insulin-like growth factor binding protein 1 (IGFBP-1)
outcome: vaginal delivery within 24 hours of starting induction
cohort: 193 term nulliparous women with intact membranes
finding: IGFBP-1 independently predicted vaginal delivery and vaginal delivery within 24 hours of induction, even after controlling for Bishop score, cervical length, and other significant characteristics.
